case.title: UPI Payment Discrepancy & Fraud Investigation
case.description: Multi-source financial and digital forensic investigation reconciling bank statements, telecom CDR records, WhatsApp communications, and altered payment receipts.

ground_truth_artifacts.role: Double-entry banking transaction ledger showing ₹25,000 UPI debit with reference RRN 429108472910.
Telecom Call Detail Records proving cell tower triangulation at Connaught Place, New Delhi during transaction window.
Exported WhatsApp chat log containing claim of ₹15,000 sent to merchant.
Metadata and OCR triage payload claiming transaction amount of ₹15,000.
Third-party customer dispute claim submitted without cryptographic signing.
Raw image bitstream of mobile payment receipt subjected to font metrics and metadata inspection.

forensic_ground_truth.epistemic_guarantee: Preserved without premature identity merge or automatic guilt classification.
